name.fr-FR: Exposition de la doctrine de l’Église catholique
name.en-US: Exposition of the Doctrine of the Catholic Church
name.pt-BR: Exposição da doutrina da Igreja Católica

description.fr-FR: Exposé dépouillé de toute polémique de la foi catholique sur les points disputés avec les protestants : le culte, l’invocation des saints, la justification, les sacrements, l’Eucharistie, la messe, l’autorité de l’Église. Rédigé en 1671 pour Turenne et approuvé par Rome, il fut l’un des écrits de controverse les plus répandus du XVIIe siècle. Avec les lettres relatives à l’Exposition et les cinq fragments de controverse. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: A plain statement, stripped of polemic, of the Catholic faith on the points disputed with Protestants: worship, the invocation of saints, justification, the sacraments, the Eucharist, the Mass and the authority of the Church. Written in 1671 and approved by Rome, it was among the most widely read works of controversy of the seventeenth century. With the letters concerning the Exposition and five fragments on controversy. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: Exposição, despojada de toda polêmica, da fé católica sobre os pontos disputados com os protestantes: o culto, a invocação dos santos, a justificação, os sacramentos, a Eucaristia, a missa e a autoridade da Igreja. Redigida em 1671 e aprovada por Roma, foi um dos escritos de controvérsia mais difundidos do século XVII. Com as cartas relativas à Exposição e cinco fragmentos de controvérsia. Edição Lachat (1864).

en-US.translator: Anonymous (Tracts on Catholic Unity, by members of the Church of England), after the Avignon edition of 1830

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XIII, pages 001-007 and 011. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.

sources.edition: An Exposition of the Doctrine of the Catholic Church in Matters of Controversy, in Tracts on Catholic Unity by Members of the Church of England, English translation of 1845 (archive.org a619496600bossuoft; OCR text, cleaned)
sources.description: A free translation of chapters I-XX of the Exposition (the text ends there; chapters XXI-XXII are missing); no notes. The French remarques, letters and fragments have no counterpart.
